newsitem.title: JAPAN: US hotel chain Radisson ties up with Miyako Hotel.
newsitem.headline: US hotel chain Radisson ties up with Miyako Hotel.

text.p: U.S. hotel chain Radisson Hospitality Worldwide and Japan's Miyako Hotel Tokyo have agreed to tie up on sales, marketing and reservation services, the two hotels said in a statement on Wednesday.

Radisson said in April that it plans to operate 75 hotels in the Asia Pacific region by 2000, up from the 16 it ran at that time, citing the region as a major growth opportunity for the travel and tourism industry. Radisson is the sixth biggest U.S.-owned hotel chain.
Radisson also said it hopes to tie up with at least four hotels in major Japanese cities, including Osaka, within five years.
